chunks: Remember, when the wife of 'Imran prayed: "O Lord, I offer what I carry in my womb in dedication to Your service, accept it, for You hear all and know everything."
ai.seo_question: What did the wife of 'Imran vow regarding her unborn child?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse is often linked to the lineage of the Ahl al-Bayt, with many scholars identifying the wife of 'Imran as Hannah (Hanin) or Asiya, emphasizing the spiritual purity of Maryam's ancestry. The concept of 'nadhr' (vow) here establishes a precedent for dedicating offspring to divine service, a theme resonating with the Imams' own roles as spiritual inheritors. This dedication underscores the divine selection process, where God accepts the vow but ultimately chooses the most worthy, foreshadowing the unique status of Maryam and her son, Isa.
